title: Nucleofector Protocol for Dinoflagellates using Lonza’s 4D-Nucleofector X Unit
author: Senjie Lin
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7n8hmhw
materials: Prepare Lonza’s nucleofector solutions: Per reaction use 16.4ul solution SF, SG, or SE and 3.6ul Supplement 1 and your DNA/Vector of choice (*Note do not add more than 10% the volume of the 20ul reaction). For K. veneficum only solution SF worked for transformation. Add 2ug of linear DinoIII- neo plasmid DNA (Table 1; Figure 1). Digest DinoIII- neo with Eco RI and concentrate as previously described (Sprecher et al., 2019).

steps.title: Prepare culture plates
steps.instruction: Prepare a 24-well plate with culture medium and antibiotics.

substeps.instruction: Add 1.4 mL of normal culture medium (e.g., F/2, L1) into each well.
For K. veneficum transformation, add 400ug/mL of ampicillin to the seawater to prevent bacterial growth.

steps.title: Harvest dinoflagellate cells
steps.instruction: Harvest cells using the lowest centrifuge speed and shortest time that achieves a good pellet with minimal damage.

substeps.instruction: For K. veneficum CCMP1975, spin cells at 1500 g for 2 minutes in 1.5mL tubes.
Harvest 200,000-400,000 cells per reaction (specifically 400,000 cells per well for K. veneficum).

steps.title: Resuspend cells for electroporation
steps.instruction: Remove seawater and resuspend the cell pellet very gently using Lonza solutions.

substeps.instruction: Remove all seawater from the pellet.
Resuspend cells using 20-22ul of Lonza solution mix (SF, SG, or SE) per reaction.
For K. veneficum, use a mix of 22uL solution 16.4 SF, 3.6 Sol I, and 2 ul linear DinoIII-neo plasmid DNA.

steps.title: Perform electroporation
steps.instruction: Electroporate the cells using the Lonza 4D-Nucleofector X Unit.

substeps.instruction: Place the 20-22ul cell solution into Lonza’s 16-well Nucleocuvette TM Strip kit wells.
Run the preprogrammed optimization procedure.
For K. veneficum, use pulse code CA-137.

steps.title: Post-electroporation recovery
steps.instruction: Recover cells and transfer them to the prepared culture plate.

substeps.instruction: Add 80ul of normal culture liquid (for K. veneficum, use L1 + 400ug/mL of ampicillin).
Resuspend cells very gently.
Transfer cells to the 24-well plate and return to normal culture conditions.

steps.title: Apply selection pressure
steps.instruction: Add selectable agents to the culture to isolate transformants.

substeps.instruction: Add selectable agent 24-72 hours after transfection.
For K. veneficum, add 150ug/mL of kanamycin 72 hours after transformation.
After 2 weeks, add new seawater containing 150ug/ml kanamycin and 400ug/ml ampicillin.
Reinoculate cultures every 3 to 4 weeks.

steps.title: Verify transformation
steps.instruction: Isolate nucleic acids and perform PCR to detect the gene of interest after one month.

substeps.instruction: Isolate DNA and RNA.
Perform PCR targeting the gene of interest; nested PCR may be required.
For the neo gene, use primers neoQF1 (GGTGGAGAGGCTATTCGGCTATG) and neoQR1N (GGAGCAAGGTGAGATGACAGGAG) for the first PCR.
Use primers neoQRF2 (TGGAGAGGCTATTCGGCTATGACT) and neoQR1 (CGGACAGGTCGGTCTTGACAA) for the nested PCR.
